name: state-machine-diagramming
description: Domain-entity state machine modeling. For a business object (order, user account, subscription, document, claim, shipment), enumerate lifecycle states, transitions with triggers + guards + effects, terminal states, and invariants per state. Distinct from state-transition-mapping (UI component states). Supports event-driven and condition-driven transitions, parallel regions, and sub-states. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
